items.titleZh: 拉塞尔进站受罚后跌至第六
items.summaryZh: 拉塞尔完成进站并接受处罚，名次跌至第六，但仍排在皮亚斯特里之前，只把位置让给了诺里斯。
items.originalTitle: Russell made a pit stop and took his penalty. That's dropped him to P6, but crucially just ahead of Piastri so he's only lost track position to Norris...
items.summaryEn: Russell made a pit stop and took his penalty. That's dropped him to P6, but crucially just ahead of Piastri so he's only lost track position to Norris #F1 #MexicoGP
detailZh: 拉塞尔完成进站并接受了处罚。这使他跌至第六位，但关键的是他仍排在皮亚斯特里之前，因此他只把赛道位置让给了诺里斯。#F1 #墨西哥大奖赛
detailEn: Russell made a pit stop and took his penalty. That's dropped him to P6, but crucially just ahead of Piastri so he's only lost track position to Norris #F1 #MexicoGP

items.titleZh: 佩雷兹遭遇慢速进站跌至队尾
items.summaryZh: 佩雷兹因一次缓慢进站跌至队尾，与博塔斯一同进入蓝旗区域，圈速因此大受影响。
items.originalTitle: Poor Perez after that slow stop, he's now into blue flag territory alongside Bottas at the back of the field, and that just kills your lap times #F1 #...
items.summaryEn: Poor Perez after that slow stop, he's now into blue flag territory alongside Bottas at the back of the field, and that just kills your lap times #F1 #MexicoGP
detailZh: 佩雷兹那次进站太慢了，真可惜，他现在和博塔斯一起在队尾进入蓝旗区域，这直接毁掉了他的圈速。#F1 #墨西哥大奖赛
detailEn: Poor Perez after that slow stop, he's now into blue flag territory alongside Bottas at the back of the field, and that just kills your lap times #F1 #MexicoGP

items.titleZh: LAP 32/71 格尼襟翼，乔治完成10秒处罚，重返第8位
items.summaryZh: 乔治在LAP 32/71时被要求进站更换中胎，并完成了10秒的处罚。他重返赛道后位于第8位，一旦林德布拉德和科拉平托停止，他的净排名将是第6位。

items.originalTitle: LAP 32/71 📻 “Box, box” comes the call to George as he heads in for a set of Mediums and serves his 10 second penalty. He rejoins in P8, which wil...
items.summaryEn:
LAP 32/71
📻 “Box, box” comes the call to George as he heads in for a set of Mediums and serves his 10 second penalty.
He rejoins in P8, which will be a net P6 once Lindblad and Colapinto stop.
detailZh:
第32圈/第71圈
📻 “维修区，维修区”的呼叫传来，乔治正要进入维修区进行一组中低速轮胎更换，并服刑10秒。
他回到第8位发车，一旦林德布拉德和科拉平托停止，这将净增第6位发车。
detailEn:
LAP 32/71
